Paighambar! Yeh munaafiqeen aap ke paas aate hain to kehte hain ke hum gawaahi dete hain ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain, aur Allah bhi jaanta hai ke aap us ke Rasool hain, lekin Allah gawaahi deta hai ke yeh munaafiqeen apne da'we mein jhoote hain
Unhon ne apni qasmon ko sipar bana liya hai aur logon ko raah-e-Khuda se rok rahe hain. Yeh un ke badtareen aamaal hain jo yeh anjaam de rahe hain
Yeh is liye hai ke yeh pehle imaan laaye phir kaafir ho gaye, to un ke dilon par mohr laga di gayi, to ab kuch nahin samajh rahe hain

Aur jab aap inhein dekhenge to un ke jism bahut achchhe lagenge, aur baat karenge to is tarah ke aap sunne lagein, lekin haqeeqat mein yeh aise hain jaise deewaar se lagaayi hui sookhi lakdiyaan. Yeh har cheekh ko apne hi khilaaf samajhte hain, aur yeh waaqai dushman hain, in se hoshyaar rahiye. Khuda inhein ghaarat kare, yeh kahaan behke chale ja rahe hain
Aur jab in se kaha jaata hai ke aao Rasool-Allah tumhaare haq mein istighfaar karenge to sar phira lete hain, aur tum dekhoge ke istikbaar ki bina par munh bhi mod lete hain
Un ke liye sab baraabar hai chaahe aap istighfaar karein ya na karein, Khuda inhein bakhshne waala nahin hai, ke yaqeenan Allah badkaar qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Yahi woh log hain jo kehte hain ke Rasool-Allah ke saathiyon par kuch kharch na karo taake yeh log muntashir ho jaayein, haalaanke aasmaan o zameen ke saare khazaane Allah hi ke liye hain, aur yeh munaafiqeen is baat ko nahin samajh rahe hain

Yeh log kehte hain ke agar hum Madina waapas aa gaye to hum saahibaan-e-izzat un zaleel afraad ko nikaal baahar karenge, haalaanke saari izzat Allah, Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye hai, aur yeh munaafiqeen yeh jaante bhi nahin hain
Imaan waalo! Khabardaar tumhaare amwaal aur tumhaari aulaad tumhein yaad-e-Khuda se ghaafil na kar de, ke jo aisa karega woh yaqeenan khasaare waalon mein shumaar hoga

Aur jo rizq hum ne ata kiya hai us mein se hamaari raah mein kharch karo, qabl is ke ke tum mein se kisi ko maut aa jaaye aur woh yeh kahe ke Khudaaya! Humein thode dinon ki mohlat kyon nahin de deta hai ke hum khairaat nikaalein aur nek bandon mein shaamil ho jaayein
Aur hargiz Khuda kisi ki ajal ke aa jaane ke baad us mein taakheer nahin karta hai, aur woh tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
